```html
<div class="w-full max-w-lg mx-auto p-4 bg-white rounded shadow-md overflow-hidden">

    @enderror

        </div>

        <div class="mb-4">
            <button type="submit" class="bg-blue-500 text-white w-full px-4 py-2 rounded shadow-md hover:bg-blue-700">Save</button>
        </div>
    </form>
</div>
```
